	}
}

	if = { limit = { owner = { has_technology_researched = modern_vaccines } } multiply = 0.6 }

	if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_private_health_insurance } } multiply = 0.85 }
	if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_public_health_insurance } } multiply = 0.75 }
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system value >= 5 } } }
		multiply = 0.77378
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system value >= 4 } } }
		multiply = 0.81451
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system value >= 3 } } }
		multiply = 0.85737
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system value >= 2 } } }
		multiply = 0.9025
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owner = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system value >= 1 } } }
		multiply = 0.95
	}
	multiply = {
		value = var:te_dg_sol subtract = 8 divide = 27 min = 0 max = 1
		multiply = -0.4 add = 1
	}
	multiply = { value = var:te_dg_lit multiply = -0.3 add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = migration_crowding
			owner = { NOT = { institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_ministry_of_urban_planning value >= 1 } } }

		multiply = 1.15
	}
}
